text:
anya: quick design pass notes — spotted a few console <-> docs friction points and a keyboard/a11y bug in the help drawer. summarizing so eng/docs/ux can triage.

jess: please keep bullets short so i can move to the docs board.

anya: issues:
- label inconsistency: console field shows 'model alias' while the docs keep saying 'Pinned model' (users hesitate during rollouts)
- help panels: some screens inline full how-tos, some show a single line + link. inconsistent expectation.
- toasts/CTAs: clicking a console CTA lands at the top of a long doc page with no context or anchor
- help drawer: ESC sometimes doesn't close, and focus doesn't return to the help trigger (screen reader users affected)

olivia: UX preference: inline micro-help = one-sentence summary + a single CTA. CTA semantics: modal = 'Open guide' (in-context), new tab = 'Open docs' (tracked). Keep the inline body under 2 lines.

tom: for deep links propose stable anchor pattern: /docs/{slug}#{section-id}. add utm params: ?utm_source=console&utm_medium=cta so docs can attribute. please keep anchors stable and documented.

kevin: telemetry idea: emit a minimal event when a CTA is clicked: {page, section_id, cta_target}. store only IDs (no doc content). also capture referrer page so we can measure which console screens drive doc reads.

docs-bot: opened RED-4112 to capture label mapping, anchor list, and CTA UTM pattern. attaching CSV template to the ticket.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist (short): add role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" to the drawer, set focus to the first interactive control on open, ensure ESC calls the same close handler as the close button, restore visible focus outlines for keyboard users, and emit a brief SR announcement like "Help panel opened".

mike: repro note: reproduced on mac+voiceover and windows+NVDA. likely a focus-trap not releasing on overlay dismissal. i'll add an e2e that asserts ESC closes the drawer and focus returns to the help icon.

jess: copy suggestions (compact):
- inline CTA (modal): "Open guide"
- external (new tab): "Open docs"
- error toast CTA: "See troubleshooting steps" -> links to /docs/errors#{error-code} with utm params
Also recommend holding a single canonical phrase for analytics, e.g., use "Open docs" for all external doc links.

olivia: small microcopy UX: when we surface the pinned/alias field show both for a short deprecation window, e.g., "Pinned model (alias: v3-stable)" so users and SDKs can map names.

anya: ok action items: 1) P0: fix help-drawer ESC/focus behavior (eng) 2) P1: produce console->docs label map and deprecation plan (docs/sdks) 3) P2: add stable anchors + UTM telemetry for CTAs (docs+eng) 4) P3: standardize inline micro-help pattern in Figma (UX)

docs-bot: RED-4112 assigned to docs-squad, ETA 3 business days. will include anchor list and recommended CTA copy.

mike: i'll pair with eng-oncall for the ESC fix and add the e2e. also will log the minimal CTA event once anchors exist.

jess: i'll post the final copy snippets and a short migration blurb for SDKs in this thread by EOD.

olivia: i'll attach Figma frames for the inline micro-help and the modal view with a11y notes.

anya: thanks everyone 44d moving this into the design doc and linking RED-4112. ping if anything else pops up.
